title: Riffle PR snapshot row
description: One PR at one moment while it was open (pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/snapshots.py), labelled with how the PR finally ended. Every column of mined_dataset.schema.json, with three groups taken as of snapshot_at instead of the PR's open: the code features of the head commit then (diff sizes, path flags, deterministic, scanner, dependency and API-contract columns), the merge signals (repo_outside_merge_rate and the rest), and the snapshot state columns. Git-history, blame, LLM and PR-metadata columns stay as at open. Labels are outcomes and never model inputs; so is near_decided. Bots count for nothing in the state. Since 1.2: outcome_3class, nowhere_reason, ci_fail_flaky_only and author_confirmed_maintainer, optional in the schema for older rows; the miner writes them on every row. Since 1.3: snapshot_weight and moment_bucket (optional in the schema; snapshots.py writes them).

snapshot_id.description: Stable id: hash of repo, PR number, trigger and time, so re-mining gives the same rows

snapshot_at.description: The moment the snapshot describes (UTC). Everything in the row is as of this moment, except labels

snapshot_index.description: Order of this snapshot among the PR's kept snapshots

trigger.description: What made this moment a snapshot: an event, or a clock (time since start, idle, no maintainer reply)

trigger_role.description: Who caused the trigger; clock for time-based snapshots

snapshot_head_sha.description: The PR's head commit at snapshot_at (or the nearest earlier captured one, see head_found)

snapshot_base_sha.description: Fork point the head's code features were computed from

head_found.description: open: the at-open head; exact: from the head line with force-push history known; approx: force-push history unreadable; capped: the true head wasn't captured, so the nearest earlier captured one is used

near_decided.description: Last hour before close, or after the PR entered a merge queue or got auto-merge. For filtering in training; never a model input

time_since_start_h.description: Snapshot state. Hours since the clock started (open, ready-for-review, or the last reopen)

time_since_last_human_activity_h.description: Snapshot state. Hours since the last non-bot event

maintainer_replied.description: Snapshot state. A maintainer has commented or reviewed

first_maintainer_reply_h.description: Snapshot state. Hours from start to the first maintainer reply; null if none yet

review_rounds.description: Snapshot state. Reviews by humans other than the author

changes_requested_count.description: Snapshot state. Changes-requested reviews so far; null when unknowable (a dismissed review in an old capture that does not say what it was before)

approvals_count.description: Snapshot state. Approving reviews so far; null when unknowable (a dismissed review in an old capture that does not say what it was before)

commits_since_start.description: Snapshot state. Commits pushed after the start (merges from the base not counted)

force_pushes_since_start.description: Snapshot state. Force-pushes after the start

author_pushed_after_last_review.description: Snapshot state. The author pushed after the latest review

author_comment_count.description: Snapshot state. Comments by the PR author

other_comment_count.description: Snapshot state. Comments by other humans

has_outcome_label.description: Snapshot state. An outcome label (duplicate, wontfix, stale, needs-info, ...) is on the PR now

marked_duplicate_so_far.description: Snapshot state. Someone marked the PR as a duplicate

is_draft_now.description: Snapshot state. The PR is back in draft

reopen_count.description: Snapshot state. Times the PR was reopened so far

new_commits_since_prev.description: Snapshot state. Commits since the previous candidate moment (kept or capped out); null on the first

new_comments_since_prev.description: Snapshot state. Human comments since the previous candidate moment (kept or capped out); null on the first

diff_size_change_since_prev.description: Snapshot state. Change in LA + LD since the previous candidate moment (kept or capped out); null on the first

miner_version.description: Repo miner version that wrote the row (version.py). Provenance (proposal 1.7, 1.8). Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/mine_repo.py`.

miner_commit.description: The miner's git commit (12 characters), with -dirty when its files had uncommitted changes, or unknown. Provenance (proposal 1.7, 1.8). Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/mine_repo.py`.

llm_model.description: LLM model the row's LLM columns were asked of; null when the LLM was off. Provenance (proposal 1.7, 1.8). Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/mine_repo.py`.

llm_prompt_version.description: Hash of the LLM prompts and schemas (flags and close-reason classifier); null when the LLM was off. Provenance (proposal 1.7, 1.8). Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/mine_repo.py`.

domain.description: Dataset domain of the repository (ADR 0011), from its [domain: NAME] tag in the repos file; null when untagged. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/build_dataset.py`.

outcome_3class.description: Training target (proposal Part 4): lands_clean (merged, no rework), lands_after_rework (merged after rework), goes_nowhere (closed unmerged, or abandoned); null when rework wasn't observable. An outcome, never a model input. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/merge_labels.py`.

nowhere_reason.description: For goes_nowhere rows: abandoned, duplicate, unwanted, ci_technical, or unknown (read, but no rule or classifier found a reason); null on merged rows and when the timeline was unreadable. An outcome, never a model input. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/merge_labels.py`.

ci_fail_flaky_only.description: True when the merge commit's required CI failure came only from checks flaky at merge time (3+ rerun-passes in the prior 90 days, rules.mining.flaky_detection); label_ci_fail is then False. Null when CI wasn't observed and on unmerged rows. An outcome detail, never a model input. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/flaky.py`.

author_confirmed_maintainer.description: The PR author had merged or closed someone else's PR before this one opened, from the repo's timelines (proposal 2.2). author_association shows today's status and hides private org members, so this is what decides outside contributors. Null when no timelines were read. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/maintainers.py`.

snapshot_weight.description: 1 / the number of kept snapshots of this PR, so each PR adds up to 1 in training and slow PRs with many snapshots don't dominate. Depends on the PR's whole history, so it is a training weight and never a model input.

moment_bucket.description: Time band of the snapshot: open (the open trigger) or time since start, for reporting metrics per moment.

llm_diff_truncated.description: True when the LLM diff size cap dropped or cut code the model would have read; false when the whole diff was shown; null when no LLM call was made (off, skipped, empty or a reused answer). Metadata about the call, never a model input. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/features/llm_flags.py`.

szz_window_closed.description: True when the SZZ observation window for the PR has closed: `szz_maturity_days` (default 90) had passed between the PR's merge and the observation cutoff (`observed_through`), so a `label_szz_bug` of false is mature. False while the window is still open: a fix that would later be traced to this PR may not exist yet. Null when the SZZ label was not computed (SZZ off, an unmerged PR) or `szz_maturity_days` is 0 (no cap, so no window). Never a model input. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/labels.py`.
